card.name: "More" before sensitive in elderly warnings
card.fires_on: The word "more" (occasionally "be") right after "may be" or "appear to be" when describing elderly or debilitated patients. It sits just before "sensitive" or "susceptible".

modes.label: More before sensitive/susceptible
modes.description: The word "more" follows "may be" in a statement that elderly patients react more strongly to a drug.
modes.example: Elderly patients may be<< more>> susceptible to drug-associated effects on the QT

modes.label: Be before sensitive
modes.description: The word "be" follows "may" in a geriatric sensitivity statement, with no "more".
modes.example: Geriatric patients may<< be>> sensitive to the effects of benzodiaz

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "sensitive" or "sensitivity" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "sensitive" in notes that older patients may react more strongly to a drug.
